title: Private: Upgrade Orbit Planner — orchestrated migration pipeline and LTS-aware rollout gates
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers running Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) need an upgrade experience that is safe, testable, and predictable across heterogeneous clusters. Current tooling requires manual sequencing for migrations that touch schema, control-plane configs, and instance-level binaries. This ticket scopes a reusable orchestrated migration pipeline ("Orbit Planner") plus an LTS-channel-aware rollout gating system that can express: blue/green and canary waves, DB schema migration hooks, preflight/health probes, cross-cluster dependency checks, and automated rollback triggers.

Goals:
- Provide a declarative pipeline format (gates-as-code) that operators can commit to their infra repos.
- Implement a controller/agent pair that executes the pipeline with strict idempotency semantics and safe concurrency controls.
- Add rollout gates tied to LTS channels and release policies so upgrades respect customer-selected LTS windows and maintenance windows.
- Integrate migration-step plugins for DB migrations, KV cache migrations, and agent binary swaps; include dry-run and simulation modes.
- Emit detailed audit logs and provide hooks for the Console to visualize wave progress and allow operator overrides.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not change the underlying package format or delivery mechanism for private builds. It focuses on orchestration and safety checks.

Constraints and risks:
- Customers run air-gapped clusters with strict egress; agents must be able to run from local artifacts and not assume external access.
- Schema migrations must be reversible where possible; fallback plan required for long-running migrations.
- Rollout policies must be pluggable to support enterprise SLA customizations.

Architecture notes:
- Orbit Planner = declarative pipeline + controller that interprets steps into per-node actions. Steps include: preflight, drain, binary-swap, migrate-schema, post-check, undo.
- Configuration expressed as YAML CRD for Private control plane (or plain YAML file for on-prem operators without CRD).
- Gates-as-code supports conditions: percent-upgraded, health-slo, external-metric, time-window, and manual-approval.
- Migration plugins run via a secure sandbox and report structured status to control plane.

Deliverables:
1) Pipeline schema and spec doc (docs/internal/private-upgrades/orbit-planner-spec.md).
2) Controller prototype with agent handshake and idempotent step engine (alpha).
3) Sample gates library and three example pipelines (canary, staggered waves, immediate LTS pin).
4) Console integration mockups and API endpoints for operator overrides.
5) Playbook and runbook for complex rollbacks and disaster recovery.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Define and ship a pipeline schema and examples; schema validated by unit tests.
2) Controller + agent demo that performs safe binary swap across a 3-node local cluster (dry-run + execution).
3) Gate evaluations working: percent-based canary, time-window, and manual approval flows; automated rollback when health SLO breached.
4) Audit logs emitted for each step with trace IDs, and Console can query and display pipeline state.
5) Documentation and runbook reviewed by Release Eng and Security; security checklist signed off.
6) Integration test runs in CI that simulate network partitions and ensure idempotency and safe retries.
